name: @nouride/isolation
description: Each Nouride agent's commands as that agent's own user: the root helper nouride-run (root/), and how the daemon finds and reaches it (src/).
comment: Everything that runs as root is in root/ and nowhere else, so the one part a security review has to read can be
read on its own: a Rust program with libc as its only dependency (root/nouride-run).
src/ is the daemon's side and runs as the daemon: it decides at boot whether the helper is there, and builds the
client's command line @nouride/runtime puts in front of an agent's command.
